messages:
Aisha (support): Hey team — customer <AcmeAnalytics> opened a high-sev ticket: after onboarding polaris-extended-long we see p95/p99 regressions for long-context (>16k tokens). They say p99 for /v1/generate went from ~450ms to ~2.3s and a handful of 502s. Grafana link: https://grafana.re/redwood/d/abcd/polaris-onboard (logs attached). Can runtime/ML look? :eyes:

Ravi (eng-runtime): Looking. Quick questions — did onboarding include a tokenizer update or a different quantized variant? Any rollout metadata?

Aisha (support): Yes, onboarding config: model=polaris-extended-long, tokenizer=polaris-tokenizer-v3, kernel=auto-quant, rollout started ~2026-03-17T09:10Z. Customer payloads are long transcripts (avg ~22k tokens).

Sophie (eng-ml): Thanks. Early guess: new tokenizer v3 introduced extra normalization pass that pushes some sequences into fallback slow path (Python-based normalization) for CJK and emoji-heavy sequences. That can blow up tokenization time and cause upstream request queueing -> p99 spike.

Carlos (eng-ml): I pulled logs for the customer. Here's a representative snippet from the node that served the slow request:```
[2026-03-17T09:17:03Z] request_id=xyz tokenization_ms=1180 kv_cache_lookup_ms=12 model_infer_ms=820 total_ms=2045
[2026-03-17T09:17:03Z] tokenizer_path=polaris-tokenizer-v3 fallback_normalizer=true fallback_reason="unicode_variant"
[2026-03-17T09:17:03Z] http_status=200
```
Fallback normalization and a concurrent batch size spike look correlated. Also saw occasional 502s when the tokenization worker pool timed out.

Ravi (eng-runtime): That matches a runtime symptom: tokenization currently runs synchronously on the request path for that tokenizer implementation. If tokenization takes >1s it holds up KV cache warmup (we only fill cache after tokenization) and other requests queue behind. Two mitigations we can apply quickly: 1) route this customer to polaris-extended-long-tokenizer-v2 (previous tokenizer) while we debug; 2) enable async tokenization worker for the rollout pool to avoid head-of-line blocking. We can do (1) immediately via routing rule.

Elaine (eng-platform): I can add a per-customer route and pin to tokenizer-v2 for AcmeAnalytics. ETA ~10m. Also can set a temporary per-route concurrency cap (to keep queue depth bounded) and enable a soft-fail early 429 for extreme tails. Thoughts?

Aisha (support): Please do routing + concurrency cap. Customer is sensitive to latency more than absolute throughput — prefer routing over 429s for now. I'll tell them we have a workaround in ~15m.

infra-bot: deploy 1779993000 detected: model-routing: add-rule AcmeAnalytics -> polaris-tokenizer-v2 (canary: true) by Elaine.

Carlos (eng-ml): To help repro, here's a minimal curl that hits the slow path (use a large unicode-rich sample):

curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \n  -H "X-Model: polaris-extended-long" \n  -d '{"input":"<paste long transcript with emojis and CJK>"}'

Sophie (eng-ml): I'll add a unit test for tokenizer-v3 normalizer to cover those unicode variants. If tokenizer fallback is the cause we should: 1) back out the normalization change for v3; 2) or push an optimized normalization path into the Rust tokenizer (not Python); 3) update our onboarding checklist to include long-context unicode-heavy corpora perf tests.

Ravi (eng-runtime): Short-term plan: pin route (Elaine), enable async tokenization for rollout pool (Ravi + infra oncall), add concurrency cap (Elaine). Medium-term: Sophie/Carlos to work on Rust native normalizer. I'll also add a runtime metric for "tokenizer_fallback_rate" so we can alert earlier.

Aisha (support): Customer updated — they confirmed measurable improvement after pinning (initial p99 dropped to ~600ms). They're OK with waiting for a proper fix. I'll keep monitoring and mark the ticket as mitigated for now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Elaine (eng-platform): rolling back canary to full route for this customer once we confirm stability for 24h. Posted follow-up: https://docs.re/redwood/onboard-tokenizer-checklist

Sophie (eng-ml): Filed internal issue RN-6521: "polaris-tokenizer-v3 unicode fallback slow path" with repro and tests. Assigning to Carlos.

Carlos (eng-ml): Will start work on the Rust path today. Also will create a small synthetic load test hitting the unicode cases to validate fixes before redeploy.

Ravi (eng-runtime): Added temporary dashboard panel: Tokenizer fallback rate and per-request tokenization_ms for polaris-* pools. Will link in the thread once done.

Aisha (support): Great — closing loop with customer. If anything regresses I'll reopen.
